items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: He played with Joe Robichaud. ... Played with Joe a long time.

ctx.x: He come here with Fate, I think. I think he did. He got the drum, Fate, at the 5, and he played with Joe Robichaud. Nice little drummer. Bucket. Okay, I agree. He wasn't from here though.
No, no. I've heard about him. Yeah, nice drummer.
